rules: A normal episode must provide one validated persona_scene before asset resolution begins.
persona_scene environment, wardrobe, props, lore, and visible dialogue are treated as one coherent directing unit.
Do not resolve a generic neutral Satoshi shot when a topic-specific persona_scene exists.
Every episode should begin with a PERSONA_HOOK unless an explicit editorial exception is recorded.
PERSONA_HOOK must use or extend the fictional persona lore ledger and must pivot directly into the real topic.
If on_camera_satoshi=true and spoken_by_satoshi=true, generate a lip-synced performance for exactly that beat's spoken words.
If on_camera_satoshi=true and spoken_by_satoshi=false, narration must pause or the shot must be an intentional silent reaction.
Never place audible off-camera narration under a close Satoshi face unless the edit makes it unmistakably non-speaking.
Fictional persona lore never satisfies factual evidence requirements.
Prefer a PERSONA_CALLBACK later in the episode when it naturally reinforces continuity or the joke.
Never generate a new Satoshi face if a canonical character asset can satisfy the beat.
Prefer Remotion-native graphics for citations, numbers, tables, endpoint comparisons, and corrections.
Prefer reusable still plates plus Remotion motion over generated video when motion does not add information.
Reserve expensive video generation for one or two story-defining hero beats.
Apply repetition penalty across the last five published episodes.
Never use an asset marked REJECT.
